reviews.review_msg: Extremely respectable guy, engaging content, organized lectures, would take it again with Farouk! I noticed the more engagement the students gave towards his lectures, the easier exams were if you attended class as he based off exam questions from class discussion questions. Go to exam prep lectures as he preps you on what to focus on.
He doesn't know ANYTHING about International Business. His English is all Greek to me. I do not know why Beedie uses people like him. His field is economics; his class is a waste of time.

Very kind professor, the negative comments are confusing because the professor is straightforward and reasonable with his expectations for the midterms. He is approachable and helpful for any questions. Highly recommend

I swear the comments below are trolls. Farouk is an excellent professor and is very knowledgeable contrary to what the comments below says about the topics at hand. He engages with his students well and takes inputs very seriously as he wants to make the experience good for everyone. I hope to see him more after the term.
